value: Alam Badi Azmi, the member for Nizamabad (Assembly constituency 347) and the oldest member of the 18th Vidhan Sabha, died in July 2026. The Uttar Pradesh Vidhan Sabha made an obituary reference to him on 3 August 2026, and its NeVA portal now reports 399 sitting members against a House of 403.
source_name: India TV - Alam Badi Azmi, five-time SP MLA, dies

value: D. Sudhakar, the member for Hiriyur (Assembly constituency 100) and then a minister in the Karnataka government, died after a prolonged illness. No by-election had been announced when this page was last checked.
source_name: Deccan Herald - Karnataka minister and Hiriyur MLA D. Sudhakar dies

value: The Karnataka Legislative Assembly Secretariat notified Dharwad (Assembly constituency 71) vacant with effect from 15 April 2026, disqualifying Vinay Kulkarni under Article 191(1)(e) of the Constitution read with section 8 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, following his conviction in a criminal case. The Karnataka High Court stayed that conviction on 31 July 2026, and the Secretariat is reported to have restored his membership on 3 August 2026. The Assembly's published members roster had not been updated to show him when this page was last checked, so no member is shown here yet.
source_name: Deccan Herald - Congress leader Vinay Kulkarni reinstated as MLA
